p1.title: Reliable maths
p1.text: No double deductions: commissions, fuel and fixed costs are counted once. Estimates are flagged.

p2.title: International
p2.text: Euro, CFA franc (XOF, XAF), Guinean franc… six languages and country-specific settings.

p3.title: Built for phones
p3.text: Quick end-of-day entry, even after long hours on the road.

p4.title: Private data
p4.text: Only you can see your figures. A fleet manager only sees what you allow.

landing.finalText: Start with today: all you need is your income, your kilometres and your expenses.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Provisional document, to be legally reviewed before production.

data.title: Data collected
data.text: Profile (country, city, language, currency), vehicles, working days, income, expenses and the receipts you choose to add. Nothing else.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: To compute and display your profitability. Your data is never sold nor used for advertising.

access.title: Who can access it
access.text: Only you. A fleet manager can access it only if you join their fleet and give explicit consent, revocable at any time. Administrators only see aggregated statistics.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Access, correction, export and deletion from the Profile page. For European users, these rights are exercised under the GDPR.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: Your data is kept while your account exists and permanently deleted when the account is deleted.

onboarding.welcome: Welcome! Let's set up your space.
onboarding.platformsNotice: DrivePro is not connected to any platform: you enter your amounts yourself. Suggestions depend on your country; check which services actually operate in your city.
onboarding.commissionHint: Optional: your usual commission rate. It is only used when the actual commission is unknown, and the amount is then flagged as estimated.
onboarding.skipHint: You can skip this step and add vehicles later.
onboarding.editLater: All these settings can be changed at any time.

profile.title: Profile and preferences
profile.privacyText: You can export all your data (JSON format) or permanently delete it.
profile.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.

settings.title: Language, currency and calculations
settings.currencyHint: All your amounts are entered in this currency.
settings.timezoneHint: Determines the date of your working days. Today: {{today}}.
settings.energyModeHint: Estimated: from km and consumption. Actual: from the purchases you enter. Never both at once.
settings.currencyChangeWarning: Changing currency does not convert your existing amounts: they will simply be shown in the new currency. No automatic conversion is applied.

fixedMethodHelp.calendar_day: Each day bears about 1/30 of the monthly cost (depending on month length), worked or not.
fixedMethodHelp.worked_day: Each working day bears the monthly cost ÷ planned working days.
fixedMethodHelp.separate: Days bear no fixed cost; it is deducted at month level.

dashboard.whereMoneyGoes: Where did my money go today?
dashboard.whereMoneyGoesMonth: Where does my money go this month?

day.distanceDirectHint: If you have no odometer readings.
day.onlyNetKnown: I only know the amount paid out
day.onlyNetKnownHint: Gross turnover will be unknown and commissions treated as already deducted.

day.netPaidHint: Optional: used to compute or check the commission.
day.energyEstimatedHelp: Cost computed from business km, the vehicle's consumption and price. Fuel purchased that day is not deducted a second time.
day.energyActualHelp: Cost equals the fuel or charging purchases entered for this day.
day.expensesHint: Monthly charges (insurance, lease…) go in Expenses › Fixed costs, so they are never deducted in full on a single day.
day.confirmDelete: Delete this day? Expenses entered on this date are kept.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Daily and occasional expenses, and monthly fixed costs.
expenses.receiptNeedsAccount: Adding receipts requires a signed-in account (secure storage).
expenses.energyNotice: On days where fuel is estimated, these purchases are not deducted a second time. They are in “actual” mode.

fixed.label: Label
fixed.explain: Fixed costs are never deducted in full on a single day. Current method: {{method}} (change it in Profile).

compare.title: Profitability comparison
compare.subtitle: The platform with the highest turnover is not necessarily the most profitable.
compare.method: Ranked by hourly profit. A result is shown only when based on at least {{days}} days and {{hours}} hours of work.
compare.prorated: Some days combine several platforms: their hours, kilometres and costs are split pro rata to turnover. This is an approximation.
compare.sortNote: Commissions include platform fees. Costs include energy, variable expenses and allocated fixed costs.

goals.monthStatus: Where do you stand this month?
goals.paceHelp: Based on your pace: {{worked}} days worked out of {{elapsed}} days elapsed.

goals.projectionDisclaimer: A projection is not guaranteed income.

goals.behind: Behind: {{amount}} would be missing at this pace.
